slices.title: Durable hook rules; gateway registry becomes a cache
slices.summary: Stores org hook rules durably in capability-core (org_hook_rules) with admin-only writes that bump the org policy revision and a cap of 200 rules per org, and turns the gateway in-memory hook registry into a read-through cache with a revision bound, proxying register and list to capability-core. Behind HOOKS_DURABLE (off keeps the in-memory registry); rules survive restarts and enforce on the next Do run.

cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p model-gateway --test hook_proxy_zdr_test
